title: From Projectors to Pizza Ovens, These Are the 21 Best Home Entertainment Gifts
gist: A Wired holiday gift guide of 21 WIRED-tested home entertainment products, framed around the author's view that hosting at home beats going out amid high city costs; notable data points are steep holiday discounts on premium TVs and projectors (Samsung S95H, LG Micro RGB Evo, Leica Cine Play 1, Anker Nebula X1). Promotional content with limited investment signal.

insights.claim: Wired's gift-guide author frames home hosting as more fun than going out, partly because everything in New York City is so expensive, and argues home entertainment upgrades extend beyond TVs to espresso machines and pizza ovens.
insights.speaker: Harry Rabinowitz
insights.so_what: Anecdotal support for a cost-driven stay-at-home consumer trend benefiting home AV and kitchen appliance makers.
insights.quote: maybe everything in NYC is too damned expensive

insights.claim: Wired calls the Samsung S95H QD-OLED the best OLED TV it has tested, and it is discounted 32% from $3,400 to $2,300 at Best Buy and Samsung during the holiday season.
insights.speaker: Harry Rabinowitz
insights.so_what: Large holiday markdowns on flagship OLED TVs signal aggressive premium-TV price competition.

insights.claim: LG's Micro RGB Evo 75-inch TV is discounted 40% from $5,000 to $3,000, with Wired describing RGB as the latest innovation in TV screens.
insights.speaker: Harry Rabinowitz
insights.so_what: RGB backlight TVs are the new premium display tech to watch; a 40% cut shows early pricing flexibility.
insights.quote: RGB is the latest innovation to hit TV screens

insights.claim: Premium and portable projectors are heavily discounted: the Leica Cine Play 1 fell 21% to $2,995 and the Anker Nebula X1 fell 37% from $2,999 to $1,899.
insights.speaker: Harry Rabinowitz
insights.so_what: Projectors are being positioned as TV alternatives for large-screen viewing, with deep holiday discounting.
insights.locator: The Best Projector for Movie Night

insights.claim: Wired names the Sonos Arc Ultra ($1,099, not discounted) the best soundbar and best all-in-one home theater audio solution, and the Sonos Move 2 is highlighted as a versatile indoor/outdoor speaker.
insights.speaker: Harry Rabinowitz
insights.so_what: Sonos holding full price on its flagship soundbar during holiday sales hints at pricing power in premium home audio.
insights.locator: Paired With the Best Sound Systems
